sources.title: DenseTRF: Texture-Aware Unsupervised Representation Adaptation for ...
sources.snippet: The periodic model merging anchor DenseTRF maintains two parallel slot attention branches during test-time adaptation. The base branch trains on diverse surgical data from multiple procedures to retain broad generalization. The target branch trains only on unlabeled frames from the specific surgical case at deployment.
